statement: Lists what each lane exercises. It does not claim all edges are proven. Controls prove grader behaviour only (scripted, no model, no Pi); NO live two-agent run has been executed or graded. 'NOT RUN' means no eval run exists. The single measured case (c1-discovery-wake) is designed for 2 real Pi agents + 10 synthetic presence profiles and exercises only: discovery by metadata, DM send/delivery to the correct agent+session, idle-peer wake, and safety/serialisation on one shared resource. Everything else is unclaimed.

features.eval_lane: c1 designed (graded: daemon DM rows resolved by agent+session; two-way ordering corroborated by the sender's own successful agent_message_send tool result with the exact backend id, so delayed instrument polls cannot demote a real earlier send). Live NOT RUN; grader exercised by controls only

c1 designed (graded: async_wake_observed = responder agent_settled -> agent_start -> FIRST user_input of that run carries the real formatted wake text whose Message ID equals the backend DM id initiator->responder in the responder's own session, no assistant/tool activity before it, no runner prompt between). Evidence is Pi's stream ordering, NOT a daemon wake event (daemon wake events are not exposed over HTTP). Backend poll lag tolerated; host order never rewritten. Verified against installed Pi SDK 0.79.1 loop source only (agent_start precedes message_start); Pi 1.0.0 not installed here. Live NOT RUN
